sections.heading: Bottom-up estimates
sections.markdown:
Committed pre-market; IDR bn.

**2026E (partial actual).** 9M-26 revenue 46,531.4, EBIT 2,673.6, NI 2,211.2 (dossier lines 52-54). Q4-26E revenue 13,970 is below the Q3 run-rate, but EBIT 976 (6.99% margin) is 74bp ABOVE Q3's 6.25%, NI 784. Full year: revenue 60,500, EBIT 3,650 (6.03%), NI 2,995, EPS 151.3. The +43.6% y/y 9M revenue (vs 9M-25 32,395.7) is price-led: the deck's FY2027E Brent 84.0 is ~34% below war-premium spot — a high-price year, not a trend. EBIT grew 30.8%; trading volume thin-margin (9M-26 5.75% vs 6.31%).

**2027E-2028E.** 2027E revenue 52,000 (-14%) as Brent normalises; EBIT 3,640 (7.0%) on price-insensitive distribution margin and the estate/utility mix (line 16) lifting margin toward FY2023's 8.4% (line 47). 2028E revenue 54,600 (+5% volume), EBIT 3,930 (7.2%). NI at the FY2025 NI/EBIT ratio 80.6% (lines 23-25); DPS at the 80.0% payout (line 45).

**Load-bearing assumptions.** Shares 19,799.8m (line 35); equity 12,155.9; net cash 691.5 after a 1,906.8 (FY2023) → 48.9 (FY2024) → 691.5 (FY2025) path — a 97% FY2024 drawdown, rebuilt in FY2025 (lines 32-33), so the buffer is cyclical, not structural; capex 1,200-1,300/yr vs FY2025 actual 1,065.4 (line 40) — JIIPE capex undisclosed, the weakest input. Segment EBIT absent (lines 16, 49-54): the JIIPE inflection is unverifiable and gets no base credit. Net debt/EBITDA -0.20x (lines 32-33, 45). No reserves or cost-curve quartile apply; the asset is the distribution network's working capital.

**Archetype and method.** dividend_income_anchor (registry rate 0.60), not commodity_capex_turnaround: no reserves, no life-of-asset capex cycle, so VAL_COMMODITY_CYCLICAL is adapted to through-cycle EBIT and dividend capacity. Spot earnings are cycle position, not value; the anchor is dividend capacity at through-cycle FCF. The SOE wrapper differs; the mature 80%-payout mechanism is AKRA's (line 45). p_up 0.55, a −0.05 deviation: 0.92x 3y FCF cover and FY2022's 34.5% payout (lines 25, 42) make the 80% payout a discretionary step-up, not entrenched; the named failure is live. Macro tilt: `balance_of_payments_pressure / CAUTIOUS` puts oil-import beneficiaries on AVOID; bear COE 12.5%. The 30-Oct DSI touches coal, not AKRA.

sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.markdown: From memory: the market frames AKRA as a high-yield fuel distributor with JIIPE a free option, anchored on dividend yield, not through-cycle earnings.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** the ~80% payout is a melting ice cube because FY2024 FCF (159.2, line 41) missed the 1,973.7 dividend (line 42), and the 2026 spike is a cyclical peak.
**Why wrong:** FY2024 was the outlier: FY2023/FY2025 covered 1.16x/1.45x, net cash is 691.5 (lines 32-33), and through-cycle EBIT held at 2.56-3.65tn (lines 21-25); JIIPE adds an unpaid non-cyclical utility/estate leg.
**What proves us wrong:** a second FCF-collapse year (FY2026 FCF <1,000), a DPS cut below 100, or JIIPE/estate EBIT flat for two years once disclosed.
**Market-implied read (Phase 2):** at 1,420 the tape capitalises FY2026E DPS 121 at 7.67% net (8.52% gross after 10% WHT) and sits 4.7% below our 1,490 base; on through-cycle DPS 104 it implies ~11.3% COE vs our 11% — a ~30bp durability premium. The market disputes durability, not level; at spot the ~7% net yield is the return, convergence ~1.9%/yr — a carry trade; hence entry below spot.

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.markdown:
1. FY2024 FCF 159.2 vs dividends 1,973.7 (lines 41-42); 3y FCF coverage 0.92x — not self-funded every year.
2. 9M-26 revenue +43.6% vs EBIT +30.8% (lines 21, 52-54): low-margin trading volume, not franchise growth.
3. FY2024 EBIT 2,562.6 vs FY2023 3,544.9 (line 23) — a 28% single-year swing; 25% ROE sits inside a 19.2-24.7% band (lines 45-47), not a step-up.
4. ROE is leverage-assisted: assets/equity 3.01x (lines 31, 34) — returns depend on payables-funded working capital.
5. Segment EBIT undisclosed (lines 16, 49-54); the JIIPE inflection may be entirely fuel-trading volume.
6. The 2026-10-30 close 1,420 is 4.7% below base; mom6 +2.3% after mom12 +38.7% (screen 2026-10-26, −8.4% off 1,580) — the re-rating has happened; residual mispricing is durability, not price.
7. 1-year range 1,070–1,580 (house series, 57 points); the 860 kill is below the whole tape, and flows are STALE (fund record empty, 0 fresh readings) — no ownership signal.

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: It is 2029; the position lost 30%: war-premium oil unwound, fuel-trading margins compressed, FY2026-27 earnings fell to the FY2024 trough, management cut the payout to fund JIIPE capex, and working capital consumed the net-cash buffer; DPS 104 fell toward 60. A 1,070-to-860 exit can clamp toward ~645 (−39.7%) through the 25% ARB band; a sizing tail, not down_pct.

sections.heading: Valuation, market state and EV math
sections.markdown:
Price 1,420 (2026-10-30, yfinance; prev 1,410), −8.4% off 1,580; 1-year range 1,070–1,580 (house series, 57 points); ADV IDR 28.25bn/day clears the 2bn floor 14x. Flows STALE (fund record empty, 0 fresh readings); float/pledge absent — disclosed gap.

**Levels and EV math.** Target 1,490 = committed base (warranted P/B 2.4x on BVPS 613.9 = 1,473; the DPS cross-check 104/(11%−4%) = 1,486 is gross — net of 10% WHT it supports ~1,337, so the target rests on the P/B leg). Kill 860 = trough DPS ~60 at 7% (857), below bear 900 — falsification, not a stop. Entry 1,070 = the one-year low, the lowest level I will defend; 28.2% below base. ARB 25% (>IDR 200–5,000): a locked 860 exit clamps toward ~645 (−39.7% from 1,070), pre-mortem tail. p_up 0.55 (0.60 shaded −0.05, above); p_down 0.45. up_pct 39.25 = 1,490/1,070−1; down_pct −19.63 = 860/1,070−1. Carry is state-consistent: through-cycle DPS 104 net (8.75%) up, trough DPS 60 net (5.05%) down, weighted 7.08%; peak DPS 121 retired. Drag 1.25 = 0.15 buy + 0.25 sell + 0.10 final tax + 0.25×2 slippage + 0.25 exit impact. expected_pct = 0.55×39.25 + 0.45×(−19.63) + 7.08×2.5 − 1.25 = **+29.21% / 2.5y (10.80%/yr CAGR vs the 10.44% house hurdle, +0.35pp)**.

**Win-state and Kelly.** p_up = 1.0: 39.25 + 8.75×2.5 − 1.25 = 59.9% / 2.5y = 24.0%/yr simple (20.6% CAGR), clears the 26.1% 2.5y hurdle by ~33.8pp; the maximum hurdle-clearing entry is 1,096 simple (139,595/E − 101.25 = 26.10) and 1,078.5 compounded (1.1044^2.5 − 1 = 28.18%); at 1,200 the same construction is ~6.0%/yr, so spot does not clear. Price-only up/|down| 39.25/19.63 = 2.00 vs library 1.67 — neither an under-set target (1,490 is committed base) nor a stop-loss kill (860 is falsification). Carry-inclusive ratio 59.9/8.3 = 7.2; the true downside is a payout cut, caught by the KPI kill (DPS <100; FCF cover <0.85x). Own-Kelly price-only 0.55/19.63 − 0.45/39.25 = **+1.7%**; carry-inclusive, state-consistent 0.55/8.26 − 0.45/59.87 = **+5.9%** (the flat-6.83-carry +7.3% was wrong; +3.9% at the old 1,110); library 0.60/15 − 0.40/25 = **+2.4%**. At spot price-only own-Kelly is −7.7%, hence the discount.

sections.heading: Bear attack
sections.markdown:
1. **Fact-check.** No fabrication: BVPS 613.9 = 12,155.9/19,799.8 (dossier 34-35); 9M-26 46,531.4/2,673.6/2,211.2 = quarterly sums (52-54); FY2024 FCF 159.2 vs div 1,973.7 (41-42). Caveat: "through-cycle EBIT 3,191" is 3.7% above FY22-25 mean 3,076 (23); "2.56-3.65" cites the forecast peak, not a dossier line. [MINOR]

2. **Carry, widest error bar.** Target capitalizes through-cycle DPS 104 (1,486); ev_math pays peak FY2026E DPS 121 (9.08%) both states. At 104: carry 7.8%, up 42.4, down -10.1 → EV 0.6×42.4+0.4×(-10.1)=+21.4%/2.5y = 8.6%/yr, under the 9.5% hurdle. "Thin clear" is a peak-DPS artifact. [MATERIAL — curable by lower entry]

3. **Down-state double-count.** Down is defined by a payout cut (kill DPS<100; pre-mortem 60) yet still pays 9.08%/yr; state-consistent carry alone takes EV under hurdle. [MATERIAL]

4. **Variant perception is noise.** Spot: 104/1420+4%=11.3% gross COE vs 11% (30bp); net of WHT 10.6% — no cheapness. Target capitalizes gross DPS while carry is net; net, target ≈1,337, up ≈+11%, not +24. [MATERIAL]

5. **Archetype misfit.** dividend_income_anchor needs a well-covered SOE/cash-cow payout (base_rates 156); AKRA is private, 3y FCF cover 0.92x, FY2024 0.08x — borrowing 0.60 without the -15% downside. At honest p_up 0.55, EV ≈7%/yr. [MATERIAL]

6. **New disconfirming fact.** FY2022 dividends 829.0 vs NI 2,403.3 = 34.5% payout (dossier 25, 42); the 80-89% payout dates only from FY2023 — a three-year discretionary step-up, not the entrenched distribution cited. Gross debt 5,712.8 (32) is +89% since FY2022; net cash 691.5 is 12% of it. [MATERIAL]

7. **Sizing/construction.** Body admits a locked 860 exit may clamp to ~645 (-46%), yet ev_math keeps -28.33%. up/down 0.85 ⇒ price-only breakeven p_up ≈54%; the cushion is the disputed carry. Entry 1,200 sits 12% above the 1y low 1,070, filling on impaired news as readily as beta. ARB gap, not days-to-exit, is the risk. [MATERIAL]

8. **Catalyst/anti-gaming.** No catalyst_date; AKRA dropped from the sleeve (absent 10-30/10-31) and flows are stale (0 readings) — no counterparty read. Idea card regime AGAINST, yet base COE stays 11%; LESSON-0001's tilt sits only in the bear. Stamps ordered/unedited; sole anomaly: the 10:14 commitment postdates the 10-30 close, so "before any market number" is unprovable. [MINOR]

**Stop-objecting price:** entry ≤1,175 (≈1,150 at p_up 0.55); at 1,200 honest EV ≈8.6%/yr, below hurdle.

**Verdict: MAJOR_REVISION.** The "thin clear" is manufactured by paying peak FY2026E DPS against a model capitalizing through-cycle DPS 104 — price the carry as you price the target and this misses its own hurdle at 1,200.

sections.heading: Re-attack
sections.markdown:
The revision is true in substance. 1: FY22-25 EBIT mean 3,076.4, 3,191 +3.7% ✓. 2: up carry 8.43% ✓. 3: down 4.865%, weighted 6.827 ✓. 4: 2.4×613.9 = 1,473 and 93.6/0.07 = 1,337 ✓ — WHT taxes dividends, not the multiple; holds. 5-6: p_up 0.55 now argued. 7: −22.52 vs −22.523 ✓; clamp −42% ✓. 8: the dossier header ("Fundamentals only — no prices, valuation multiples, analyst targets or estimates") makes the pre-market claim TRUE. EV recomputes exactly: 18.83 − 10.13 + 17.075 − 1.25 = 24.51.

**Hurdle [MATERIAL — entry-curable].** 9.5% is the cash proxy (INDO cash 5.50% + 4%), not the house rule: base_rates fr_duration_carry and BOND_FR_MATH line 8 set FR+4%; 10y FR 7.16% (JSMR-002 line 49) → ~11.2%, the correction ASII-002 line 134 already conceded. Required 2.5y 27.9% simple / 30.3% compounded against 24.51% delivered (9.8% simple, 9.17% CAGR) — 3.4/5.8pp short. And even on 9.5% the clear is rounding: at the computed P/B base 1,473 (the thesis's own), EV = 23.69% — 0.06pp under — and the hurdle-clearing entry falls to 1,109. The +0.76pp is bought by the 1.13% round-up to 1,490. FR+4%-clearing entry ≈1,081 simple, ≈1,061 compounded.

**Surviving.** [MATERIAL] ARB tail disclosed (−42%) but unpriced: a 10% clamp probability in the down state takes EV to 23.6% and down to −24.46% — it erases even the padded clear; carry it in size. [MINOR] Body Kelly applies flat 6.83 carry to both legs; state-consistent is 0.55/11.61 − 0.45/54.06 = +3.9%, not +7.3% (quarter-Kelly ≈0.95%). [MINOR] "Q4 EBIT 976 (6.25%)" is 6.99% (976.4/13,968.6) against Q3's 6.25% — Q4 is the residual to committed FY EBIT, 74bp above not below the run-rate. [MINOR] Net cash 1,906.8 → 48.9 → 691.5 (dossier 32-33): a 97% FY2024 drawdown the thesis omits.

Symmetry 1.52 vs library 1.67; kill 860 = 60/7% = 857 is falsification, not a stop (though 7% is below the thesis's 11% COE; 60/0.11 = 545 sits inside the clamp).

**Verdict: MAJOR_REVISION.** The revision fixed the carry and paid with the entry, then measured it against a hurdle 1.7pp too low: at FR+4% the 1,110 entry earns 9.8%/yr against 11.2%, and even the 9.5% margin is a 1.13% target round-up.

**Stop-objecting: entry ≤1,081 (≤1,061 compounded); size carries the ARB tail.**

sections.heading: Judge verdict
sections.markdown:
**Verdict: PASS_REDUCED — size_multiplier 0.25 — at a price (entry 1,070, resting limit; tail-inclusive ceiling ≈1,071).**

Governing hurdle: **10.44%/yr** — 10y FR net carry (7.16% × 0.9 = 6.44%) + 4% (BOND_FR_MATH §4, "net carry" per §2 after the 10% coupon tax). Drew's 11.2% is gross — rejected; the analyst's 10.44% is the strictest honest bar in the 5–10y band (5y 10.03%, cache 10.26%).

1. **Lint.** `pass: true`; sole WARN is whole-file 3,080 vs 1,600, structural from the immutable attack/revision logs; analyst body ≈1,267 words at the 1,200 operative cap — treated non-blocking. Stage chain monotonic and role-correct (draft 10:31:44 → attacked 10:57:30 → revision 11:01:53 → re_attacked 11:31:06 → revision 11:39:11); Bear logs verbatim and adversarial, no retro-edit, no consensus contamination.
2. **Verdict margin.** The +0.35pp clear (10.80% vs 10.44%) is real but thin; after the admitted ARB tail it is ~10.48% (+4bp). Positive EV at honestly derived levels and no dispositive flaw → PASS, not KILL; a marginal kill would spend the 30-day cooldown on a defensible name and leave INDO 89.6% cash against its 60–95% band.
3. **Entry at the 1y low = PASS at a price, not a 6a defect.** Payoff 2.00 (>1.3), kill not widened into the ARB band, p_up shaded only 0.05 with citation — the triple-haircut pattern is absent. Entry 1,070 is the hurdle-derived ceiling coinciding with the 1y low, not a momentum anchor; it rests as a price trigger.
4. **Residual → size.** The surviving MATERIAL (ARB tail: a 10% clamp moves the down state to −21.64%, EV to 28.31%) is a sizing input, not dispositive. Undisclosed JIIPE capex (no base credit) and the private-issuer archetype misfit are the unverified inputs → starter size 0.25.

Fit: oil_gas on a fuel distributor is inventory/price beta, not reserve beta, and the script pins the name to the stricter oil_gas −7% rather than the broader energy −6% — conservative. domestic_cycle is the JIIPE estate/chemicals/industrial-demand leg; PGAS carries the identical pair. **Concentration in disguise:** the tags are honest but blind to the book's real bet — Indonesian domestic energy demand. Post-trade at 2.50%: oil_gas 8.69% (MEDC 6.19 + AKRA 2.50), ENERGY sector 8.69%, domestic_cycle 6.71% (ERAA 4.21 + AKRA 2.50), digital_id 4.21%. The shared lever is the macro call — oil-import-beneficiary AVOID under balance_of_payments_pressure / CAUTIOUS — which hits AKRA (importer) and MEDC (producer) on opposite oil-price signs: a partial hedge, not a doubling. **Post-trade book heat (Σ|position × stress move|, worst tagged factor per name): IDR 137.86mn = 0.90% NAV** (ERAA 0.29 + MEDC 0.43 + AKRA 0.18pp), from 0.73% today, vs the 12.0% budget. **Governor headroom:** NAV 15.2716bn vs peak 15.4424bn (dd −1.11%); the −8% REVIEW level 14.2070bn leaves IDR 1.0647bn = 6.97% of NAV; the −15% DEGROSS level 13.1260bn leaves IDR 2.1456bn = 14.05%. A full stress day post-trade consumes 12.95% of the REVIEW room; the clamped down-state (finding 8) consumes 7.76%.

2. **Stress-table honesty — PASS at this size.** Per-position 1-day loss at the proposed 2.50% (worst tagged factor, script convention): ERAA.JK 4.21% NAV × digital_id −7% = −IDR 44.97mn (−0.294% NAV); MEDC.JK 6.19% × oil_gas −7% = −IDR 66.16mn (−0.433%); AKRA.JK 2.50% × oil_gas −7% = −IDR 26.73mn (−0.175%). Book heat after: **−IDR 137.86mn = 0.90% NAV**, vs 0.73% now. At the undiluted 10.00% anchor: AKRA −IDR 106.90mn, book heat 1.43% NAV. Both inside the 12.0% budget. Honest caveat: the pinned −7% is a factor beta; AKRA's real stress day is inventory revaluation plus an estate-demand gap, and a policy shock can hit both legs at once — the table likely understates that joint move. No recalibration proposed here (MONTHLY_IC duty, needs realized worst days).

3. **Concentration — PASS.** Name cap at cost 10.00%: proposed 2.50% (10.00% anchor). Sector ENERGY 8.69% vs 30.0%; factor oil_gas 8.69% vs 40.0% soft / 60.0% hard; gross post-trade 12.90% vs 100%; single trade 2.50% vs 5.0%; 3 names vs 15. Nothing binds but liquidity. At the full 10.00% anchor oil_gas = ENERGY 16.19% and domestic_cycle 14.21% — still inside 40/30. **The anchor equals the 10.00% at-cost cap; it is not above it.**

4. **Liquidity — FAIL-CLOSED at the ruler, PASS on house data.** Script ADV for AKRA.JK is null, so days-to-exit is undefined and the cap is 0.00%; `the risk checker` will VETO. On house data, the FULL position at 20% ADV (screen adv 29.08bn → 5.82bn/day) is **0.066 days at 2.50% (IDR 381.79mn)** and 0.263 days at 10.00% (IDR 1.527bn); on the thesis's 28.25bn, 0.068 / 0.270 days. Far under 7. The tape can absorb the exit; the source cannot certify it. **Do not stage until refresh-adv writes a finite AKRA ADV**; if it persists after one refresh, the source returned no volume history and the name is untradeable until fixed.

5. **Kill-criteria hygiene — PASS, with two monitor-pipeline notes.** Price 2027-06-30 with the compound condition (FY2026 payout 0.5x): monitorable at the date, sources named. No vague criterion; nothing returns to the analyst.

6. **Sizing audit — process clean; anchor binds at zero today.** `sizing.pm_pct` is null. Script anchor `recommended_pct` = 0.00% and `hard_max` = 0.00% because the ADV ruler is blind; kelly_quarter 25.00% less the 10.3% correlation haircut = 22.43%, not binding. The Judge's 0.25 applies after this review: 0.25 × 0.00% = **0.00% NAV today.** Once ADV populates at the house 29.08bn, the liquidity cap is 258.98% (non-binding), the anchor is the 10.00% at-cost cap, and the Judge's 0.25 permits **2.50% NAV = IDR 381.79mn**. The anchor is not above the constitution cap. Any `pm_pct` > 0 written today is above the script anchor — a process breach, VETO-level; after ADV populates, `pm_pct` ≤ 10.00% and the staged tranche ≤ 2.50%, downward deviation only.

7. **Horizon balance — GAP, flagged.** risk_check NORM: short-horizon theses below the 2 minimum; the book is 2 long holdings plus this long candidate, zero short. Flagged in writing; no trade is forced or manufactured to clear it. Deployment: cash 89.6% vs the 60–95% band; a 2.50% starter takes cash to 87.1%, still above band — deployment pressure is not a reason to skip the ADV gate, and §9a forbids it.

8. **ARB-clamp tail — carried in size, not EV.** At a 10% clamp probability the down state is −21.64% and EV 28.31%/2.5y = **10.48% CAGR vs the 10.44% hurdle, +4bp.** The tail consumes the entire +0.35pp margin; the honest edge after it is 4bp. Tail-inclusive own-Kelly is still ~9.8x NAV full (~245% quarter), so Kelly does not bind — liquidity (today) and the 10.00% cap (once ADV exists) do. **Size I permit: 0.00% now; once ADV is finite, no more than the Judge's 2.50% NAV.** At 2.50% the tail-inclusive down loss is IDR 82.62mn (−0.54% NAV, 7.76% of the REVIEW room); at 10.00% it is IDR 330.48mn (−2.16% NAV, 31.0% of the room) bet on a 4bp edge — not permitted on this evidence.

sections.markdown:
Sized at 2.5% NAV vs the script anchor's 10.0% — downward deviation only, applying the Judge's PASS_REDUCED 0.25 multiplier (0.25 × 10.0 = 2.50%). Script: constitution_cap 10.0% binding; liquidity cap 324.75% non-binding at ADV IDR 35.42bn/day; book heat 0.73% → 1.43%.

Entry rests as a waiting limit at 1,070 — 24.6% below the 1,420 close, so nothing stages pre-open. Max fill 1,070 × 1.03 = 1,102.1; it tickets when price enters the 10% staging band.

Deployment context: INDO 89.6% cash, below the 60–95% band — this starter is a step toward it, not a reason to chase. Voss CLEAR-with-notes at this size (ADV now finite; tail-inclusive cap 2.50%). Carry-guard: carry +16.4pp against a −19.63 down leg still nets a negative total, so the guard is not tripped.
